settings.heading: Description
settings.content: Distilled from organically grown Lavandula angustifolia. Floral, herbaceous, and calming — ideal for winding down before sleep.

settings.heading: How to use
settings.content: Add 4–6 drops to a diffuser, or dilute with a carrier oil for a pulse-point roll-on. Never apply undiluted to skin.

settings.heading: Ingredients
settings.content: 100% Lavandula angustifolia (lavender) essential oil. Nothing else.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Free shipping over $50. Ships in 1–2 business days. Unopened bottles returnable within 30 days.
